desk.headline: Adjusted EPS $0.71 beats $0.64 estimate on flat $3.75bn revenue; 2026 guidance midpoints raised

other.label: Free cash flow (excl. deal and restructuring costs)

results: Revenue was flat at $3.75bn: new products, North America and Greater China (+14%) offset supply problems in Europe and emerging markets.
Supply constraints, mainly from the Nashik plant in India, cost about $100m of revenue in the quarter; the plant is shut for repairs until early 2027.
Adjusted EPS rose 6% to $0.71 and the adjusted gross margin widened to 58% from 56%.
On a GAAP basis the loss widened to $325m ($0.28 a share), mainly because of a higher tax charge.
About $717m has been returned to shareholders this year, including $300m of buybacks; a $1.65bn cash deal for Pacira BioSciences should close by end-November.

guidance.summary: Viatris raised the midpoint of every 2026 target: adjusted EPS is now $2.56–2.63 and adjusted EBITDA $4.45–4.55bn. The revenue range was tightened to $14.7–14.9bn. Guidance leaves out the Pacira deal.

items.metric: Free cash flow (excl. deal and restructuring costs)

points: North America sales grew about 7% at constant currency, led by complex generics such as estradiol patches; capacity is being expanded.
Nashik supply problems should cost about another $100m of revenue in Q4; production is expected to restart in Q1 2027.
Pacira is expected to add to all financial targets in 2027, funded with cash and short-term borrowing, with over $50m of yearly cost savings by end-2028.
Fast-acting meloxicam has an FDA decision date of 27 Dec 2026, with launch planned for early 2027; management gave no 2027 guidance.
China growth slowed to about 10% as new hospital buying rules took effect, and is expected to ease further in Q4.
call.source: Earnings call transcript — The Motley Fool, 5 Nov 2026; Zacks, 5 Nov 2026

watch: Closing and integration of the Pacira deal, and its first contribution in 2027.
Restart of the Nashik plant in Q1 2027 and the end of the roughly $100m-a-quarter revenue hit.
The FDA decision on fast-acting meloxicam due 27 Dec 2026.
